purpose: Apply the P27–P35 source-tier and representation rules retrospectively to data already present in Kenya Data Atlas, including existing omission and closure states.
publication_presumption: Prefer representation with truthful source-tier, confidence, period, method and conflict labels whenever a defensible value exists. Omission is the last resort.
audit_scope: county, constituency and ward values surfaced by place profiles
P18–P26 preferred observations and governed closure states
official_unavailable, governed_unavailable, boundary_unresolved and retired/replaced states where the underlying indicator remains active/relevant
CountyIQ/results values whose source lineage comes from canonical observations
public source labels, source links and catalogue metadata
required_tests: Classify every in-scope current preferred observation to S0–S7 where possible.
Detect observations sourced through secondary evidence but currently labelled or implied as official or unspecified.
Re-open in-scope unavailable/omitted states and search for credible S2/S3/S4/S5 representation opportunities.
Detect conflicts where only one preferred value is retained and reconstruct competing candidates where defensible evidence exists.
Detect repeated copies of one upstream source and collapse them to one evidence lineage for corroboration purposes.
Check that secondary/modelled/probable values are not omitted solely because they are non-primary.
Preserve historical values and prior decisions while correcting provenance classification and current preferred-state treatment.
representation_opportunity_rule: If credible evidence can support the indicator at the correct geography/period/definition, prefer publishing it at the lowest truthful source tier rather than retaining an unavailable/omitted state.
do_not_promote_when: geography cannot be reconciled or transparently modelled
evidence lineage is circular or not independently verifiable
uncertainty or conflict is too material for a preferred value even with disclosure
publication would breach rights, privacy, safety or source restrictions
acceptance: 100% of in-scope current preferred observations receive an audit disposition.
100% of in-scope unavailable/omitted states are reviewed for credible labelled representation.
Zero known current secondary observations remain unlabelled after remediation.
Every newly representable legacy omission is either promoted or has an explicit documented reason for remaining unavailable.
Every identified legacy conflict retains candidate evidence and a conflict disposition.
Historical lineage remains auditable; the audit does not rewrite prior release history.
